negative_findings.finding: Compact delay-PCA linear-system mean eigenvalue error is approximately 0.333, much worse than identity smoke recovery.
Multiscale AR mean eigenvalue error is approximately 0.274 and remains weak.
Negative regime-conditioned recovery errors are approximately 0.464 to 0.504, so switching-process recovery is poor in that regime.
The current matched-eigenvalue metric ignores unmatched spurious and missing modes and can reward low-rank recovery that omits planted modes.
The current mode-truncation ablation ranks individual eigenvalues rather than conjugate groups.
The reported frequency response is an autonomous-operator resolvent proxy, not a complete identified input-output transfer function.
